<title level="1" right="Action">[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) <actions string="" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 299

</column>

---

Spells can vary in how many actions they take, as shown in the spell’s stat block. You cast [cantrips](/Rules.aspx?ID=2227), spells from [spell slots](/Rules.aspx?ID=2222), and [focus spells](/Rules.aspx?ID=2228) using the same process, but must expend the spell when casting a spell from a spell slot and must spend 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell. Some rules will refer to the Cast a Spell activity, such as “if the next action you use is to Cast a Spell.” Any spell qualifies as a Cast a Spell activity, and any characteristics of the spell use those of the specific spell you’re casting.

See rules for [Casting Spells](/Rules.aspx?ID=2233) for more information.
